module: Plays the interface sounds (audio channel "AudioGui") from the file ui/soundClasses.json. Each sound class contains events; a simple event plays an sfx once, a "source" event creates and reuses a managed audio source (play, setParameters, stopBeforePlay, recreateBeforePlay). Also used for the long-press sounds (bng_hold_activate: start, complete, cancel).
notes: The sound classes are loaded into M.ui_sound_classes on the first onFirstUpdate (jsonReadFile('ui/soundClasses.json')).

An event is "managed" (persistent source) if it has type == 'source' or one of the fields sourceKey, action, parameters, stopBeforePlay, recreateBeforePlay. Otherwise, with only sfx, it is played by Engine.Audio.playOnce('AudioGui', sfx).
Managed sources are cached by key sourceKey (or sfx) suffixed with ':instanceId'; a source whose object no longer exists in scenetree is recreated.
The recognized managed actions are 'play' (default) and 'setParameters'; any other value does nothing (the source is still created).

ui_sound_classes.desc: Contents of ui/soundClasses.json (class -> event -> definition). Filled by onFirstUpdate; nil before.

onFirstUpdate.desc: Hook called by the engine on the first update: reads ui/soundClasses.json into M.ui_sound_classes ({} if absent).

playEventSound.desc: Plays the event eventName of the class className. Does nothing if the class or the event does not exist. Simple event: plays the sfx once on AudioGui; source event: creates/reuses the source, applies the parameters then starts it (play(-1)).

className.desc: Name of the sound class in soundClasses.json.

eventName.desc: Name of the event in the class.

instanceId.desc: Optional instance identifier to have a distinct source per UI component (inferred from code: concatenated to the cache key).

startHoldActivateSound.desc: Plays the "start" event of the bng_hold_activate class (start of a long press).

instanceId.desc: Instance identifier of the managed source.

completeHoldActivateSound.desc: Plays the "complete" event of the bng_hold_activate class (long press completed).

instanceId.desc: Instance identifier of the managed source.

cancelHoldActivateSound.desc: Plays the "cancel" event of the bng_hold_activate class (long press released too early).

instanceId.desc: Instance identifier of the managed source.
